user.title: Add an AllEars phone
user.description: Give this phone a name. Each phone running AllEars gets its own device, webhook and entities.

data_description.device_name: For example "Bedroom phone". You can change it later.

webhook_url.title: Connect the AllEars app
webhook_url.description:
**1. Copy this URL** (phone on the same Wi-Fi as Home Assistant):

`{webhook_url}`

Away from home, use this one instead: `{remote_url}`

**2. In AllEars**, open a flow, add the action **Trigger Webhook** and paste the URL. Add it to every flow you want Home Assistant to hear about.

**3. In AllEars → Settings**, tap **Sync Flows with Home Assistant** so your flows show up in automations and on the dashboard card.

Select **Submit** to finish. You can see this URL again under the integration's **Configure** button.
